1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 15 m de altura, de corteza gris y verrugosa, hojas ovaladas, flores en ramos pequeños que brotan de una rama central, fruto negruzco y semillas pequeñas y redondas en cápsulas individuales algo velludas. (Lauraceae; Ocotea globosa).
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Tree reaching a height of up to 15 m, with grey and verrucose bark, oval-shaped leaves, small clusters of flowers emerging from a central branch, dark fruit, and small, rounded seeds in individual capsules that are slightly hairy.

(Lauraceae; Ocotea globosa)
